name: Izonshou no Ane
source:
My beloved little brother, Tsu-kun, is crying.

“Sis,...... sorry, nee,...... sorry,......”

He was sobbing like a child, with lots of tears in his eyes while he was sniffing his nose.
I gently pressed my lips to the forehead of such a sweet and lovely Tsu-kun.

I was so happy to see him. It's okay, Tsu-kun, I don't mind, okay?　Don't cry.

Forgetting about wiping away the semen that was overflowing from my secret place with a tissue, I just held my brother in my arms.

This is a twisted love story between a broken brother and an older sister who accepts everything.
translation:
我心爱的弟弟津君正在哭泣。

“姐姐，……对不起，呐……对不起……”

他像孩子一样抽泣，眼里满是泪水，还不断吸着鼻子。
我轻轻将嘴唇贴在如此甜美可爱的津君额头上。

看到他，我感到无比幸福。没关系，津君，我不介意，真的。别哭。

我忘了用纸巾擦掉从隐秘处溢出的精液，只是把弟弟抱在怀里。

这是一个破碎弟弟与包容一切的姐姐之间的扭曲爱情故事。
